text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Jose Eduardo dos Santos met the U.N. Secretary General Kofi Annan at Futungo presidential palace last night.
- U.N. military chief to Angola, Phillip Sibanda, has admitted the possibility of the formation of an Angolan unity government within the next few days.

- Angolan Foreign Minister Venancio de Moura, in a full-page article, has accused UNITA of dragging out the peace process and has urged the Security Council to implement threats of sanctions against the rebel movement.
